changelog: Google Drive Backup Fix: Resolved 'Upload failed:' error by constructing standard RFC 2387 multipart/related payloads instead of unsupported browser FormData, with descriptive error parsing.

Manual File Import / Local Restore Fix: Fixed parameter unpacking bug in the SQL layer and implemented direct atomic Dexie transactions with bulk inserts, ensuring 100% data retention of students, attendance, fee challans, and exam results upon restoration.
Non-Cascading Student Promotion: Resolved the cascade bug in Class Management by snapshotting class assignments and promoting without chain contamination.
Graduated Students Management & Reactivation: Full recovery interface with 1-click student reactivation, smart historical class reconstruction from fee/exam records, and undo promotion support.
